_comment: The C4 closeout package is a HISTORICAL SNAPSHOT. Its producer_commit ran the private-host executions behind it and generated its raw evidence; repointing that field at a later commit would be false provenance, because no later producer generated those artifacts. This sidecar records the lineage instead of mutating the snapshot.
note: The historical C4 package is not a current-main harness certification. A successor is published as a SEPARATE addendum carrying this snapshot's full digest as its parent -- never by editing the snapshot. The addendum is gated on owner S16-6 and on the two correctness items it named: event-local temperature for the internal-cap enthalpy, and a basis-consistent window inventory.
